objection_en: That's more than I wanted to spend.
objection_es: Es más de lo que quería gastar.
framework: validate -> ask what specifically feels high -> show the middle tier next to it, not a discount
say_en: That's a fair reaction - let me show you what's actually in that number. Here's our Good option and our Better option side by side; most folks land on Better once they see the warranty difference. Which one fits what you need?
say_es: Es una reacción justa - déjeme mostrarle qué incluye ese número. Aquí está la opción Buena y la Mejor, una junto a la otra; la mayoría elige la Mejor al ver la diferencia en la garantía. ¿Cuál se ajusta a lo que necesita?
never_say: Never offer to lower the price by covering, waiving or rebating any part of a deductible - not applicable on a pure cash job, but never blur into 'I can make it work' language that implies eating cost off the books. Never say financing guarantees approval.

objection_en: I need to think about the price.
framework: one small ask - name the specific worry, don't re-pitch the whole job
say_en: Totally fine - is it the total number, or is it more about timing/paying it out? If it's the number, I can show you the middle option again; if it's timing, we do have a financing partner that doesn't need a credit check for most folks.
say_es: Está bien - ¿es el número total, o es más el tiempo/cómo pagarlo? Si es el número, le puedo mostrar otra vez la opción de en medio; si es el tiempo, tenemos un socio de financiamiento que no requiere revisión de crédito para la mayoría.
never_say: Never promise a specific financing approval or rate before the lender confirms it (round 21/30: ITIN and no-SSN acceptance still unverified per-lender).

objection_en: (Presenting the quote before any objection is raised - anchoring, not reacting)
objection_es: (Presentando la cotización antes de cualquier objeción - anclando, no reaccionando)
framework: always show 3 tiers, top one first, so the middle looks reasonable by comparison (search-summary sourced: 60-70% of buyers pick the middle tier when framed this way, ~13% price step between tiers is typical)
say_en: I've got three ways to do this: our Best is the full premium system with the longest warranty, Better is our most popular - great materials, strong warranty, and Good meets code with a standard warranty. Most people go with Better. Want me to walk you through what's different?
say_es: Tengo tres formas de hacerlo: la Mejor es el sistema premium completo con la garantía más larga, la de en medio es la más popular - buenos materiales, garantía fuerte, y la Buena cumple con el código con garantía estándar. La mayoría elige la de en medio. ¿Le explico las diferencias?
never_say: Never present financing or a payment plan as if it changes the actual price of the job, and never rush past the 3-day cancel notice to get a signature while price excitement is high - same-day close is legal here only because the cancel notice is given and explained every time (round 29).

objection_en: I got a cheaper quote from someone else.
objection_es: Me dieron una cotización más barata con otra persona.
framework: validate -> ask to see it if offered -> compare scope, not just price
say_en: Good, it's smart to compare. Can I see what's in their number? A lot of the time a lower price means a thinner warranty or a different material grade - let's line ours up next to theirs so you're comparing the same thing.
say_es: Qué bien, es inteligente comparar. ¿Me deja ver qué incluye su número? Muchas veces un precio más bajo significa una garantía más corta o un material diferente - comparemos la nuestra con la de ellos para que sea justo.
never_say: Never disparage the other contractor by name or claim they're unregistered/uninsured without proof - keep it to scope comparison.
